title: Rename billingUrl->billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and 3 apps (mono only; platformkit has no refs)

summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its 3 consumers (core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports) in one mono PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in mono and is inlined at build, so no library publish/version bump needed; platformkit has no references so untouched; all 3 apps built locally OK.
